title: How is furnace length determined for a 120-minute heating and holding cycle in an aluminium chain furnace?
summary: A Suneng discussion draft for an aluminium-alloy chain-conveyor furnace proposes discharge every 20–22 seconds per part, 4 parts per row and a combined heating-and-holding time of 120 minutes. Whether these requirements work together depends on actual fixture-row pitch and effective furnace length. Workpiece drawings are still missing, so calculations based on a provisional 100 mm pitch do not establish compliance with the site's space allowance.
coverCaption: AI-generated aluminium-alloy billet illustration, not an actual customer workpiece photograph. It does not depict the workpiece geometry, dimensions or row pitch in the original proposal.
